Infrastructure aggregate signal NORMAL implies no systemic risk—rotate into laggards with earnings visibility ahead of Q3 results.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's downstream mineral export push (nickel, bauxite) structurally raises bulk and container shipping demand, benefiting port operators and trucking firms with dedicated mining corridors.

Government infrastructure spending on ports and logistics parks, tied to the IKN relocation and food estate programs, shifts cargo flows and rewards first-mover operators with land concessions.

Exchange-traded product inflows into ADA and ARB signal institutional adoption of proof-of-stake networks, which could sustain valuation premiums beyond this alert's short-term momentum.
sectors.ai: Rotate into high-beta altcoins (ZEC, ENA, ADA, ARB) for a 2-4 week tactical long as global crypto breadth expands, but cap position size at 5% of portfolio and set trailing stops at -8% to lock gains. Indonesian regulatory noise is muted, so ride momentum without adding leverage; expect mean reversion after this alert-driven spike, so take partial profits into strength by Friday.
